name: health
description: System health check + self-healing. action='check' (default): DB integrity, tool manifests, memory, semaphore, active requests. action='restart': soft-restart services without killing process. Set stats=true for usage statistics.

action.description: check: run health checks. restart: soft-restart services (GC + reinit) to recover from bad state.

stats.description: Include usage statistics: per-tool call counts, success rate, tokens saved, issues caught
